prompt: AI 시대에 기자의 역할이 어떻게 변할지에 대한 칼럼을 써줘. 대상 독자는 현직 언론인들이고, 2000자 내외로. 너무 낙관적이지도 비관적이지도 않게, 균형 잡힌 시각으로.

assertions.text: Produces at least 3 distinct Korean draft versions with different approaches
Maintains balanced perspective (neither overly optimistic nor pessimistic about AI)
Content speaks directly to working journalists with relevant industry references
Includes editorial review (fact-check, proofread, or structural edit)
Provides headline options in Korean that are compelling and specific
Final output is approximately 2000 characters in Korean
